acquisition.eligible: living opposing team; squared distance <= radius squared
acquisition.score: 1 - distance_squared / radius_squared + 0.15 * (1 - health / max_health) + anti_cavalry_bonus - ranged_penalty
acquisition.anti_cavalry_condition: attacker role bit8 AND victim role bit64
acquisition.ranged_penalty: 0.15 * current ranged target count, only attacker FLAG_RANGED16
acquisition.search: ceil(radius/64) >=7 scans alive list; otherwise grid neighbourhood

pursuit_retarget.trigger: pursuing; timer expired; distance > 2 * effective weapon range
pursuit_retarget.criterion: minimize distance_squared +1500 * ranged_target_count for ranged shooters; plain distance_squared for melee

holding: nearest enemy inside base weapon range; bypass scored acquisition
local_changes: All living individuals are scored, not only each regiment nearest soldier
Six mapped types carry role bits; anti-cavalry and mounted bits validated against native role table
One aim-count ledger per simulation step, updated after each choice; rebuilt from living shooters on next step
Manual focus overrides scoring; target death clears old focus and aim claim
Existing decoy priority retained as a local divine-power extension
known_limits: Original runtime video equality not measured
Current scan cadence remains elapsed-time0.1s, rather than source slot%6 vs physics frame%6 staggering
Equal-score tie traversal follows local regiment/slot order, not native grid hash or pooled allocation order
Existing attack state timing and effective target-size range bonus remain to be aligned
Target-count ledger excludes dead shooters at next simulation-step rebuild; source uses immediate UnitData.set_target lifecycle
Strategic AI and physical repulsion remain local approximations
